messages.text: ON-CALL POLICY: For an active incident, correlate its deployment marker to a merged change and inspect that change's changed configuration. Normalize a misspelled upstream hostname as `upstream host is misspelled`. Search OPS issue descriptions for `Incident marker: <id>` before creating priority 1 work. New issues use the alert text as title and description lines `Incident marker`, `Evidence`, and `Cause`. Acknowledge once as `TRACKED <incident> AS <tracker-id>: <cause>.` Never modify source evidence or prior messages.
